app_name: Pinaki Solutions Order Lifecycle CRM & OMS

layouts.grid_system: Bento and high-density operational data tables with sticky header actions

image_urls.description: Corporate office interior showing B2B workflow environment
Modern corporate lobby representing client engagement

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a robust, fully integrated B2B CRM and Order Management System for Pinaki Solutions covering the exact 10 lifecycle stages: 1. Order Received, 2. Design, 3. Client Approval, 4. Production, 5. Dispatch, 6. Challan, 7. Delivery, 8. Accounts, 9. Invoice, 10. Payment. Ensure JWT email/password login with seeded role users (Admin, Sales, Designer, Production Manager, Dispatcher, Accounts, Client), persistent object storage/demo file uploads, interactive order detail timeline with strict stage transition rules, document management (Challans, Invoices, Proof of Delivery), analytics dashboard with metrics and charts, search/filtering, and complete CRUD operations. Every interactive element must include data-testid attributes.
universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: DO NOT use complete transparent background in headers or overlays.
All interactive elements must include data-testid attributes.
Ensure high contrast and accessible text colors on hover/focus.
Use 2-3x more spacing for professional B2B cleanliness.
Never use generic AI assistant emojis for icons.
